Definition: from G5093; expensiveness, i.e. (by implication) magnificence:--costliness.
BiblicalUsage: Once only, and it is the wealth of a doomed city. In Revelation 18:19 the merchants weep over Babylon because all who had ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her costliness, and in one hour she is made desolate.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single use is a warning in itself: riches built on that city's trade vanish in an hour.
